name: Foster Electric Company, Inc.
old_description: Foster Electric was founded in 1956 by Mr. Aubrey E. Foster, Sr. (1919-2008). At that time, he was the sole employee; and the business was located in the garage at his residence. Mr. Foster would arise at 4:30 – 5:00 AM each morning and load his vehicle for the day’s deliveries and customer sales. Having completed his rounds by 5:00 – 6:00 PM, he would arrive home to start his office duties: writing up customer orders, invoicing sales, receiving remittances and making deposits, ordering merchandise from manufactures, receiving materials and sorting customer orders for the next day’s business. As you can imagine, his was a very busy schedule. But, in addition to all his business duties, he still found time for his family, church and community commitments.
about:
Foster Electric Company, Inc. was founded in 1956 by Aubrey E. Foster, Sr. in Lynchburg, Virginia. The business began in the garage of Foster's residence, where he operated as the sole employee, handling deliveries, sales, invoicing, and procurement. In 1958 the company moved to a downtown storefront at 707 Fifth Street, and by 1965 had relocated to a 14,000‑square‑foot facility on Campbell Avenue with seven employees. The current 45,000‑square‑foot office and warehouse complex at 1420 Campbell Avenue was acquired in 1982. Today the company is an employee‑owned ESOP led by President Duane White.

From its Lynchburg facility Foster Electric operates as a full‑line electrical supply distributor. The company stocks and sells electrical equipment for residential, commercial, and industrial applications, and provides delivery service throughout central Virginia along with same‑day shipping anywhere in the continental United States. A staff of approximately 32 employees supports sales, warehousing, and logistics operations.

The distributor serves four primary customer segments: residential and small contractors, industrial and commercial large contractors, industrial maintenance/repair/operations (MRO) buyers, and industrial OEM accounts. Its product range covers the needs of construction trades, plant maintenance departments, and original equipment manufacturers across the region.

Foster Electric emphasizes its independence as a locally owned distributor, which it says keeps the company in close contact with customer needs. The firm highlights fast delivery and competitive pricing as core commitments, positioning itself as a value‑added partner rather than a simple reseller.
